claims.text: Between 1996 and 2003 Hathaway conducted the Podkletnov spinning-superconductor gravity experiment for a prospective investor and reported null results.

claims.nodeLabel: The Role of Superconductors in Gravity Research
claims.text: The paper reviews the rotating-superconductor gravity-modification claims associated with Evgeny Podkletnov and the work of Ning Li. Hathaway had personally run a Podkletnov replication between 1996 and 2003 and obtained null results, so DIA commissioned the review from a researcher with a documented record of failing to reproduce the effect.
